name: Lead Scorer
summary: Scores new HubSpot leads daily, explains the rating, and posts the top 5 to Slack.

items.title: HubSpot lead reader
items.description: Fetches new leads from HubSpot every morning.
items.proved_when: New leads are successfully retrieved from HubSpot.

items.title: Lead scoring agent
items.description: Scores each lead from 0 to 100 based on company size and recent activity, and writes an explanation.
items.proved_when: Every fetched lead receives a score and explanation.
items.source_quote: score new HubSpot leads from 0 to 100 using company size and recent activity, explain each score

items.title: Slack poster
items.description: Posts the top 5 scored leads to the sales channel.
items.proved_when: A message containing the top 5 leads appears in the channel.

items.title: Morning run schedule
items.description: Triggers the lead scoring and posting workflow every morning.
items.proved_when: The workflow runs automatically at the scheduled morning hour.

items.title: Leads database
items.description: Stores scored leads and explanations for tracking.
items.proved_when: Scores and explanations are saved and viewable.
items.source_quote: score new HubSpot leads from 0 to 100

questions.text: Which Slack workspace should the leads be posted to?

not_in_this_version.title: Manual lead trigger button
not_in_this_version.reason: The request specifically asks for an automated morning schedule rather than on-demand runs.
